string-array.name: changelog
string-array.item: Give any exercise in a custom workout an alternate, then swap between them as you train
Build your own workout: create a custom plan, then add your own days and exercises
Edit mode lets you adjust sets, reps, rest, and notes on a custom workout
Effort chart: see how each set compares to your training trend, right on the exercise screen
Set history now groups your sets by session, with per-session totals and PR badges
Calendar now aligns to real dates
